project.name: pickleball_app
project.description: A luxury dark-themed Flutter application integrated with Supabase Auth and Postgres profiles, featuring court bookings, live analytics, and interactive calendar scheduling.

nodes.summary: Central design system providing luxury dark theme styling, neon green/gold accents, typography, and glow effects.

nodes.name: darkTheme
nodes.summary: Constructs the comprehensive ThemeData for dark mode featuring Inter typography and high-contrast surfaces.

tour.title: Project Architecture & Setup
tour.description: Start with the project documentation and package manifest to understand the application dependencies, Supabase integration, and luxury dark theme design.

tour.title: Application Bootstrap & Initialization
tour.description: Explore main.dart to see how Flutter initializes bindings, loads .env variables, sets system UI overlay brightness, and safely bootstraps Supabase.

tour.title: Luxury Design System & Core Theme
tour.description: Understand the central design tokens, neon green accents, dark surface hierarchy, and reusable UI components like NeonButton and CustomTextField.

tour.title: Authentication Flow & Route Guarding
tour.description: Discover how AuthGate uses a reactive StreamBuilder on AuthService to seamlessly navigate between LoginScreen and MainNavigationScreen.

tour.title: Court Discovery & Reservation Workflow
tour.description: Trace the primary booking experience where players select dates and times, calculate prices, call BookingService, and receive animated confirmation modals.

tour.title: Analytics Dashboard & Calendar Integration
tour.description: Examine how user booking histories are visualized in charts on AnalyticsScreen, listed on MyBookingsScreen, and exported to Google Calendar via CalendarLinkService.
